messages:
Rhiannon Ng: Dropping a compact dark-mode pass for the Traffic & Errors dashboard. Main asks: make legend chips readable at small widths, improve inline code token contrast in the event drawer, and choose chart colors that survive photocopies/screenshots. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx

Diego Morales: Good baseline. Two immediate things: (1) legend text at 12px on #0e1113 reads thin—bump to 13px semibold or increase contrast; (2) the amber series currently used merges with alert red in screenshots.

Iris Park: For inline code in the drawer, current token colors are low-sat. Suggest inline bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.03), inner stroke 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04), and token palette: keyword #8ed8ff, fn #bdebb0, string #ffd99e, number #ffb77a.

Caleb Stone: Accessibility notes: legend toggles must be tabbable with a visible focus halo (2px). aria-pressed should reflect visibility. Hit area min 28px on mobile. Also add patterned lines (dash/dot) as an option for color-ambiguous series.

Diego Morales: Proposed accessible palette (aiming >=4.5:1 vs bg #0e1113):
--blue: #4ea8ff
--warm: #ffb879
--magenta: #d08cff
--mint: #7ef0c7
legend label -> #eaf5ff

ContrastBot: Automated audit: old amber vs bg => 2.6:1 (FAIL). proposed warm (#ffb879) => 5.2:1 (PASS). legend label vs bg => 7.0:1 (PASS). focus halo currently missing (FAIL).

Rhiannon Ng: I'll update Figma tokens and add a note: 13px legend min, dashed-line variants, inline code stroke, and a11y toggle. Will open a small PR with the theme JSON, focus util, and copy tweak for the tooltip ("Toggle series visibility").

Iris Park: Added comments in Figma with token names + pattern IDs. Also left a sample snippet for drawer code styling.

Caleb Stone: Quick follow-up: ensure the chart export (PNG) respects the patterned lines so printed reports don't lose meaning.

Rhiannon Ng: Good call  I'll include export spec in the PR. Planning to ship as micro release after QA verification. Closing thread once PR is green. :rocket:
